New Mexico Educational Retirement Board Has Lowered Stake in Public Storage (PSA) by $4.30 Million as Market Value Declined May 9, 2018 - By Maria Brooks
New Mexico Educational Retirement Board decreased its stake in Public Storage (PSA) by 59% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. New Mexico Educational Retirement Board sold 20,671 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.82% with the market. The institutional investor held 14,365 shares of the real estate investment trusts company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $3.00M, down from 35,036 at the end of the previous reported quarter. New Mexico Educational Retirement Board who had been investing in Public Storage for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $36.77B market cap company. The stock increased 0.34% or $0.72 $210.75. About 243,945 shares traded. Public Storage (NYSE:PSA) has declined 10.33% downtrending. It has underperformed by 21.88% the S&P500.
New Mexico Educational Retirement Board, which manages about $2.64B US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 19,900 shares to 496,466 shares, valued at $84.02M in 2017Q4, according to the filing.
